description:
“Please appear on our program just once. I’m begging you.”

PD Kim Seongyun produces a show that introduces children to different professions by inviting people from various career fields. This time, he is looking to cast hoteliers and people who run hotels and resorts. Among his target list is Seo Hanhee, the CEO of SC Hotel & Resort, and Seongyun struggles to secure him.

“I have no intention of appearing on television.”  
“Could you at least give us one interview? We’ll come to you in person.”

After endless pleading, Seongyun finally manages to go interview the difficult Hanhee. At least, that is what Seongyun thought at the time. He had no idea Hanhee would end up clinging to him.

After the interview, Hanhee not only agrees to appear on the show but also starts contacting Seongyun on his own. Filming and editing wrap up smoothly, and Seongyun wants to cut off contact now that everything is done, but…

Why does this man keep calling me?  
Why is he sending so many messages?

The unhinged, straight-ahead pursuit of a younger Alpha man begins, aimed squarely at an aloof older Omega man.
